title: MCP
description: Review and revoke apps connected through Koi.
revokeDescription: This connection will stop working immediately.
loadError: Could not load access. Try again.
revokeError: Could not revoke access. Try again.
connectDescription: Choose where you use your agent, then add Koi as an MCP server.
serverStep: Use this MCP server URL and choose OAuth authentication.
urlError: Could not load the MCP URL.
reviewHint: Your agent will open Koi to request access. Review the permissions before allowing it.
copyError: Could not copy the URL. Select it and copy it manually.
chatgptStep: In ChatGPT, add a custom MCP server and paste this URL.
claudeStep: In Claude, add a custom remote connector and paste this URL.
codexStep: Run codex mcp add koi --url followed by this URL.
claudeCodeStep: Run claude mcp add --transport http koi followed by this URL.
cursorStep: In Cursor, add an HTTP MCP server named koi and paste this URL.
oauthStep: When prompted, sign in to Koi and review the requested access.
